A failed run, one marked holding, and no recorded trades today

Paper trading · 2026-10-26T17:00:44.631949-04:00

The scheduled daily run failed at 19:15:41 UTC while validating asset records: 10 entries used the unsupported exchange value TXSE. The supplied records therefore do not show a completed daily decision, approved or rejected proposal, submitted order, or fill. At the 21:00:44 UTC cutoff, the paper account snapshot reported $2,000 cash and equity. The active mean-reversion book held 0.053191 MU shares and had snapshot-marked equity of $1,998.34; the other two books reported $2,000 cash and marked equity. Snapshot values describe recorded observations, not guaranteed live prices. The latest supplied performance records are older than today's cutoff.

Today's lesson: A snapshot is not a trade

A proposed or intended action is not the same as an approved action or a fill. Here, the scheduled run failed asset validation, so the records show no completed decision or order to assess and no fill to report. Separately, the MU book mark uses a quote observed at 20:00 UTC: $908.76 versus a $939.88 average purchase price, or about $31.12 lower per share. For 0.053191 shares, that works out to the reported unrealized loss of about $1.66 before fees.

Reading the price snapshot

The MU valuation quote was observed at 20:00:00 UTC on October 26, while the report cutoff was 21:00:44 UTC. The quote's bid was $863.27 and ask was $954.24; their midpoint is about $908.76. The book uses that observed midpoint for its holding value. Because the quote is a timestamped snapshot, it does not establish a guaranteed closing price or prove that any trade occurred.

What to watch next

Watch whether a later scheduled run completes successfully and whether any orders or broker or simulated fills are recorded. The supplied MU quote was observed at 20:00 UTC, before the 21:00:44 UTC report cutoff; it is a snapshot, not a guaranteed closing-price feed. Older performance snapshots may also predate today's activity.

Observed midpoint: A recorded price estimate based here on the midpoint between the bid and ask. It is tied to its observation time and is not guaranteed to be a live or closing price.

Unrealized P&L: A gain or loss on a holding that has not been sold, calculated here using the book's observed price and excluding fees.

Data timing and limitations

Prices come from recorded snapshots, not a guaranteed closing-price feed.
Paper account holdings use the latest recorded snapshot, which may precede fills.
Book marks use observed bid/ask midpoints at price_as_of, not guaranteed live prices. Without an admitted quote the value remains unknown; book gains exclude fees.
Work starting after the cutoff is outside this report. Failures remain labelled.
